args.message:
FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

round_money's docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212 but the
implementation quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build
failure in tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Fixes nightly build failure in CI.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: FIN-212: implement banker's rounding in round_money
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. E.g. `Decimal("2.665")` rounds down to `2.66` under HALF_UP (in the test's context) but the implementation differs from the spec'd behavior.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, matching the behavior already documented in its docstring ("banker's rounding ... per FIN-212").

## Verification

- CI on this branch (run `ci-0001`, commit `08d3cd5986`) passed.

Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.
